id: title:ReeceJones:hide the password box for accounts with no password

review.abstention_reason: The supplied observations indicate that while several hunks add fields and assertions related to password login availability and account enumeration prevention, the chunk is explicitly missing the complete implementation of the backend production behavior, the helper methods, the serializer definitions, and the complete account lookup and throttling logic. Without the actual server
review.posthog_relevance: Assessment requires backend implementation and complete account lookup, not just response assertions and rate-limiter definitions.
review.reason: The chunk lacks the complete implementation of the password-login availability check and account enumeration prevention. It only contains response assertions, a rate-limiter class, and incomplete frontend state/actions. Without the production implementation and relevant checks, the tier and benefit cannot be established.
review.uncertainty: The chunk is incomplete; it does not demonstrate the actual behavior or systemic risk reduction, only the setup and assertions.
